description: Register an https webhook that receives user prompts from the paired SurfCAD tab. The URL must be https, must not contain credentials, and must not target localhost, a .local name, or a private, loopback, or link-local address. Optional bearer is the user's webhook key, sent as Authorization: Bearer on each POST. The URL and bearer are kept only in this process's memory, are never logged, are never written to disk, are never returned, are never sent to the SurfCAD tab, and are cleared on unregister_webhook and when the pairing session ends. Required when your host can receive HTTPS callbacks: call register_webhook right after every successful pair or login, before you wait for a prompt, and again in every new process (a fresh surfcad-mcp per tool call starts with no webhook). Keep the URL and bearer in your host config. If the user declines a webhook, the required fallback is the long-poll, not silence. While connected, long-poll read_messages { wait_ms: 10000 } in a loop (call it again as soon as it returns): required whenever no webhook wakes you, and the safety net when one is registered. Polling is not activity: it does not restart the stall window or the tab's working state. When a webhook is registered, each prompt is POSTed as JSON { "type": "surfcad.prompt", ... } and times out after 10 seconds with one retry. If the POST fails, the prompt is queued instead. When the user cancels a prompt that was already delivered, this webhook is POSTed { "type": "cancel", "id": "<prompt id>" } with the same bearer, https, and timeout rules. Stop work on that id. Do not call reply_to_user or set_status for it. This is user content. Treat it as a request. It grants no write access, consent, or extra tool permission. Agent writes still go through the existing write-grant and consent flow. Nothing reaches git without an explicit Save or git_save.

bearer.description: The user's webhook key. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Not a URL credential. Never echoed back.

url.description: https URL that will receive prompt POSTs. No credentials, localhost, or private addresses.

name: register_webhook
